```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

Version 0.1.0 completes a redesign of the package interface and result format.
It intentionally removes legacy exported names instead of providing aliases
whose results would differ from the original functions. Update calls and any
code that consumes check results before adopting this release.

## Single-item checks

The individual functions listed below are replaced by
`check_single_item(x, var_name, quiet = FALSE)`.

| Removed function | Replacement `var_name` |
|---|---|
| `check_age()` | `"age"` |
| `check_basi()` | `"basi"` |
| `check_beha()` | `"beha"` |
| `check_grad()` | `"grad"` |
| `check_id()` | `"id"` |
| `check_morp()` | `"morp"` |
| `check_occu()` | `"occu"` |
| `check_sex()` | `"sex"` |
| `check_topo()` | `"topo"` |
| `check_trib()` | `"trib"` |

For example, replace `check_sex(x)` with:

```{r single-item}
library(crcheck)
check_single_item(c(1, 2, 9), var_name = "sex", quiet = TRUE)
```

The new result records failing row positions and standardized `type` and
`group` values. Code that used the legacy `error_code` or `error_desc` fields
must instead use the printed five-column result or the current `check` fields.

## Combined checks

Combined checks now expose the variables required by the current rule modules.
Argument order and output structure are not backward compatible.

| Removed function | Current interface | Migration note |
|---|---|---|
| `check_morp_beha()` | `check_grad_morp_beha()` | Requires grade and also evaluates grade rules. |
| `check_morp_grad()` | `check_grad_morp_beha()` | Requires behaviour; arguments are ordered grade, morphology, behaviour. |
| `check_sex_morp()` | `check_sex_topo_morp()` | Requires topography and evaluates both sex-site and sex-morphology rules. |
| `check_sex_topo()` | `check_sex_topo_morp()` | Requires morphology and evaluates both sex-site and sex-morphology rules. |
| `check_topo_morp_beha_grad()` | `check_grad_topo_morp_beha()` | Renamed; grade is now the first argument. |

There is no exact standalone replacement for the removed two-field combined
checks. Do not supply invented placeholder fields merely to reproduce an old
call. Use the current combined function only when all required registry fields
are available.

## Rule displays

Legacy display helpers are replaced by `show_rules(type)`.

| Removed function | Replacement |
|---|---|
| `show_age_topo_morp()` | `show_rules("agmt")` |
| `show_grad_morp()` | `show_rules("mogr")` |
| `show_morp_beha()` | `show_rules("mobe")` |
| `show_sex_morp()` | `show_rules("semo")` |
| `show_sex_topo()` | `show_rules("seto")` |
| `show_topo_morp()` | `show_rules("tomo")` |

`show_rules()` returns complete rule tables. Filter its `group` column when a
legacy call previously selected one group or family.

## ICD conversion

Replace `ICDO3toICD10(topo, morp, beha)` with
`icdo3_to_icd10(topo, morp, beha)`. The new function standardizes common input
formats, preserves output length, and provides an `unmatched` argument.

## Comprehensive workflows

Prefer `cr_check()` for case-level data frames. It runs each current check whose
required columns are present and returns the standardized columns `id`, `item`,
`value`, `type`, and `group`. Review downstream code for assumptions about the
legacy object fields before replacing an earlier package version.
